name: Muramite Industrial: Discord Reactor
summary: A massive arcane-industrial reactor that channels raw Discord energy into industrial power for Muramite foundries and warfronts.
description: The Discord Reactor is the industrial heart of the Muramite Dominion. Raw Discord energy is siphoned from fissures, stabilized through arcane pylons, and converted into power for foundries, refineries, and siege fabrication lines. Reactor Wardens maintain containment protocols while Discord-forged constructs roam the inner chambers. The air crackles with unstable energy, and reactor surges can warp stone, flesh, and machinery alike.
